node.title: Re^5: IPC::Run3 error
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
It seems that, of the myriad ways that one might attempt to get a glob of Unicode filenames in Perl for Windows, approximately 0% of them work.

I gave you code that works fine for me [id://11141922|here]. As I've said twice before, if you show us specifically what is wrong, we'll likely be able to help you fix it.
